article.title: Conflicting accounts after Stockton pedestrian crash
article.text: STOCKTON — A pedestrian was hit by a car on Pacific Avenue on Wednesday night. Police said the man was crossing outside a crosswalk; a witness told KXYZ the man had the walk signal. Police initially reported one person hurt, but a hospital spokesperson said two pedestrians were treated for injuries. The cause remains under investigation.

incidents.circumstances: Accounts differ on whether the pedestrian had the walk signal and how many were hurt
